safety.helmetTitle: Always Wear a Helmet While Riding Two-Wheelers
safety.helmetMessage: A helmet greatly reduces the risk of serious head injuries and can save your life.
safety.seatbeltMessage: Seat belts protect you during sudden stops and accidents. Ensure every passenger is buckled up.
safety.drinkDriveMessage: Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs puts your life and others' lives at risk.
safety.trafficRulesTitle: Follow Traffic Rules and Speed Limits
safety.trafficRulesMessage: Obey traffic signals, avoid overspeeding, and stay alert to prevent road accidents.
safety.mobilePhoneTitle: Do Not Use Mobile Phones While Driving
safety.mobilePhoneMessage: Using a mobile phone while driving distracts you and significantly increases the risk of accidents.
